name: Neural Light Field (NeLF) via R2L Distillation
definition: A method that distills a pre-trained Neural Radiance Field (NeRF) teacher model into a Neural Light Field (NeLF) student model. The NeLF maps a 4D oriented ray directly to 3D RGB color, bypassing the ray-marching and alpha-composition steps required by NeRF, resulting in a single forward pass per ray.
